name: @gabrielpule/mcss-lite
description: Lightweight CSS framework with semantic BEM components and design tokens. Production-ready subset of MCSS principles.
naming: BEM: block, block__element, block--modifier. State: data-state="value" on the block.

values.light: Light theme. Also the default when no data-theme attribute is set.
values.auto: Follows the operating system via prefers-color-scheme.

rules.title: Components never set their own outer margin
rules.text: Never add margin to a c-* root element. Put components inside a layout primitive (l-stack, l-cluster, l-grid, l-sidebar, l-switcher) and let it provide the spacing.

rules.title: Layout, then component, then utility, then token
rules.text: Solve a need with an l-* layout primitive first, then a c-* component and its modifiers, then a u-* utility. Only write custom CSS as a last resort, and then use var(--token) values only.

rules.title: Never invent class or token names
rules.text: Use only the classes, modifiers, elements, data-state values and tokens listed in this file. If something is missing, write custom CSS with existing tokens instead of guessing a name such as c-button--warning.

rules.title: States use data-state plus the native or ARIA pair
rules.text: Express component state with data-state="…" (for example data-state="error"), and always add the paired native attribute or ARIA listed for that state (disabled, aria-invalid, aria-busy).

rules.title: Theme with semantic tokens, never raw values
rules.text: Never hard-code colors (#hex, rgb()) or pixel spacing. Use semantic tokens (--color-text-default, --color-action-primary…) or component tokens (--button-primary-background…). Primitive color tokens (--color-gray-*, --color-blue-*) do not adapt to dark mode.

blocks.name: Badge
blocks.description: A short, non-interactive label for status or category, such as "Beta" or "Paid".

values.name: primary
values.description: Brand emphasis, e.g. "New".

values.name: success
values.description: Positive status, e.g. "Active".

values.name: warning
values.description: Needs attention, e.g. "Expiring".

values.name: error
values.description: Negative status, e.g. "Failed".

values.name: info
values.description: Neutral information, e.g. "Draft".

use: Keep badge text to one or two words.
avoid: Making a badge clickable; use c-button--sm instead.
Relying on badge color alone to convey meaning; the text must carry the status.

a11y: Color is decorative; the badge text must describe the status on its own.

blocks.name: Button
blocks.description: Triggers an action. Apply to <button>. Apply to <a> only when the control navigates. Parts have a 2px keyline and a brick edge that drops when pressed.

values.name: primary
values.description: The main action in a view region. Use at most one per region.

values.name: secondary
values.description: Outlined in the action color; for important but not main actions.

values.name: ghost
values.description: No border or background; for low-emphasis actions such as Cancel.

values.name: danger
values.description: Destructive, hard-to-undo actions such as Delete. Brick red.

values.name: sm
values.description: Compact button for dense UI such as tables and toolbars.

values.name: lg
values.description: Large button for hero or empty-state calls to action.

states.name: disabled
states.description: The action is unavailable. Rendered ghosted with a dashed keyline.
states.pair: On <button>, also set the disabled attribute. On <a>, set aria-disabled="true" and remove href.

states.name: loading
states.description: The action is in progress. Shows moving stripes; text keeps full contrast.
states.pair: Set aria-busy="true" and aria-disabled="true", keep the visible label (for example "Saving…"), and ignore activation in your handler.

use: Group buttons with l-cluster; it provides the gap.
Order a button group as secondary or ghost actions first, then the primary action last.
Write labels as verbs that name the outcome: "Save changes", not "OK".
For toggle buttons (for example a theme switch), set aria-pressed="true" on the selected one; it gets the pressed style automatically.
Use c-button--danger for the confirming action of anything destructive, never c-button--primary.
avoid: Adding margin to .c-button. Spacing belongs to the layout parent.
Combining two variant modifiers (for example c-button--primary c-button--ghost).

a11y: A button needs a visible text label, or aria-label when it only contains an icon.
Use type="button" unless the button submits a form.
c-button--sm looks compact but keeps a 44px tall hit area.

examples.html: Read the docs

blocks.name: Card
blocks.description: A raised surface that groups related content, such as a summary, a settings group or a list item.

values.name: elevated
values.description: Stronger shadow to lift the card above its neighbors.

values.name: bordered
values.description: Keyline only, no brick edge; for flat, dense layouts.

values.name: interactive
values.description: The whole card is clickable; shows hover feedback.

elements.name: header
elements.description: Top area; holds the title and optional badges.

elements.name: title
elements.description: Card heading. Use the heading level that fits the page outline.

elements.name: footer
elements.description: Bottom area for actions or metadata; has a top divider.

children: Elements appear in the order header, body, footer. All are optional.

use: Place cards in l-grid or l-stack; the layout sets the gap between cards.
For c-card--interactive, make the card an <a> or put one link inside whose area covers the card.
avoid: Putting several competing links inside a c-card--interactive.

a11y: An interactive card must be reachable with the keyboard: use a real <a> or <button>, never a click handler on a <div>.
Keep the title a real heading so screen reader users can navigate by headings.

blocks.name: Form field
blocks.description: Wraps one form control with its label, help text and error message.

elements.name: error
elements.description: Error message shown when the control has data-state="error".

children: Order: c-form-field__label, then the control (c-input), then c-form-field__help and/or c-form-field__error.

use: Stack several c-form-field blocks with l-stack.
avoid: Adding margin to .c-form-field; the layout parent spaces fields.

a11y: Connect label and control with for/id.
Give help and error elements ids and list them in the control's aria-describedby.
Use role="alert" or a live region on the error when it appears after submit.

blocks.name: Input
blocks.description: Single-line text entry. Also styles <textarea> and <select>.

states.name: error
states.description: The value is invalid. Adds a heavier bottom edge so the state does not rely on color.
states.pair: Set aria-invalid="true" and aria-describedby pointing at the c-form-field__error message.

states.name: disabled
states.description: The field cannot be edited. Rendered ghosted with a dashed keyline.

use: Always wrap in c-form-field with a c-form-field__label.
Use the right type attribute (email, tel, number, search) so mobile keyboards match.
avoid: Using placeholder text as the only label.
Setting a width on .c-input; it fills its container. Constrain the container instead.

a11y: Every input needs a programmatic label: <label for> on c-form-field__label.
Error text must be linked with aria-describedby, not only shown in red.

blocks.name: Label
blocks.description: Deprecated standalone label. Use c-form-field__label inside c-form-field instead; c-label will be removed in 1.0.

blocks.name: Modal
blocks.description: A dialog over the page that blocks interaction until dismissed. Works on <dialog> (preferred, opened with showModal()) or on a <div role="dialog">.

elements.name: backdrop
elements.description: Dimmed layer behind the dialog; clicking it may close the modal.

elements.name: header
elements.description: Holds the title and close button.

elements.name: close
elements.description: Icon button that closes the dialog.

elements.name: footer
elements.description: Actions, right-aligned. Put the primary action last.

states.name: closed
states.description: Hidden (div form). With <dialog>, use the open attribute / showModal() instead.
states.pair: When closed, return focus to the control that opened the modal.

children: c-modal contains c-modal__backdrop and c-modal__container as siblings.
c-modal__container contains header, body and footer in that order.

use: Use for short, focused tasks: confirmations, small forms.
Buttons in c-modal__footer are c-button; the footer provides the gap. Use c-button--danger for destructive confirmations.
avoid: Opening a modal from another modal.
Long, scrolling content; use a page instead.

a11y: Prefer <dialog class="c-modal"> opened with showModal(): the browser then handles focus, Escape and inertness. With a <div>, set role="dialog", aria-modal="true" and manage focus yourself.
With the <div> form, make the page behind inert and lock scrolling while open, trap focus, close on Escape, and return focus to the opener.
c-modal__close needs aria-label="Close" and an SVG icon, not a text glyph.

blocks.name: Utilities
blocks.description: Single-purpose overrides with !important. Use sparingly; reach for a layout or component first.

classes.name: u-text-left
classes.description: Align text to the start (left in left-to-right languages).

classes.name: u-text-right
classes.description: Align text to the end (right in left-to-right languages).

classes.name: u-margin-0
classes.description: Remove margin, e.g. from a heading or paragraph inside a component.

classes.name: u-sr-only
classes.description: Visually hidden but read by screen readers.

use: u-sr-only for accessible labels on icon-only controls.
avoid: Stacking several utilities to restyle a component; add a modifier to its contract instead.

tokens.name: --color-gray-450
tokens.description: Lightest gray with 3:1 contrast on white and on gray-800; used for control borders.

tokens.name: --color-primary
tokens.description: Brand color. For UI, prefer --color-action-primary, which adapts to dark mode.

tokens.name: --color-blue-600
tokens.description: Night-build primary: white text 4.6:1, at least 3:1 on every navy surface.

tokens.name: --color-yellow-400
tokens.description: Brick yellow: new-part call-out and focus halo only.

tokens.name: --font-family-sans
tokens.value: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

tokens.name: --font-family-display
tokens.description: Rounded display face for step numerals and wordmarks. Not loaded by the framework; load Rubik yourself or it falls back to the system face.

tokens.name: --space-element-gap
tokens.description: Gap between sibling elements inside a component.

tokens.name: --color-text-subtle
tokens.description: Tertiary text: help text, placeholders, icons. 4.5:1 on every background, canvas included.

tokens.name: --color-text-link
tokens.description: Link text. Links are also underlined.

tokens.name: --color-background-canvas
tokens.description: Instruction-page canvas for showcase and marketing pages; not for dense product UI.

tokens.name: --color-background-muted
tokens.description: Muted fill for neutral badges and chips.

tokens.name: --color-background-raised
tokens.description: Cards, modals and other raised surfaces.

tokens.name: --color-background-callout
tokens.description: The 1:1 call-out that introduces a new part.

tokens.name: --color-background-success
tokens.description: Background for success messages and badges.

tokens.name: --color-background-warning
tokens.description: Background for warning messages and badges.

tokens.name: --color-background-error
tokens.description: Background for error messages and badges.

tokens.name: --color-background-info
tokens.description: Background for info messages and badges.

tokens.name: --color-border-keyline
tokens.description: The 2px ink keyline around every part: cards, controls, call-outs.

tokens.name: --color-border-interactive
tokens.description: Borders of controls (inputs, default buttons). Meets 3:1 non-text contrast.

tokens.name: --color-border-success
tokens.description: Border for the success state. At least 3:1 against fields.

tokens.name: --color-border-warning
tokens.description: Border for the warning state. At least 3:1 against fields.

tokens.name: --color-border-error
tokens.description: Border for the error state. At least 3:1 against fields.

tokens.name: --color-border-info
tokens.description: Border for the info state. At least 3:1 against fields.

tokens.name: --color-action-neutral-hover
tokens.description: Hover background for ghost and icon buttons.

tokens.name: --color-focus-ring
tokens.description: Solid 2px focus ring: at least 3:1 on every background in its theme.

tokens.name: --color-focus-ring-error
tokens.description: Focus ring on a control in the error state.

tokens.name: --color-focus-halo
tokens.description: Outer halo around the focus ring: the yellow "new part" highlight in light, a dark gap in dark.

tokens.name: --shadow-raised
tokens.description: Brick-edge depth for raised parts: a 2px edge plus a soft blur.

tokens.name: --shadow-elevated
tokens.description: Lifted parts (elevated cards, modals). In dark mode a light rim keeps the edge visible.
